_about: The feature list on the product site. A feature is shown as 'In the beta' only when every entry in 'evidence' is present at build time: a file glob must match at least one file, and 'screen:<id>' must be a screen registered in Shell/Destinations.swift with a real view, not a PendingFeatureView; 'view:<Name>' must be a view used by such a registration, whatever its id. Otherwise it is shown as 'Coming'. Write 'what' so it is true once the code is merged. Screens and views count only when AppShell is the root view of the app's @main WindowGroup; 'root:<text>' must appear in that WindowGroup. 'text:<glob>::<text>' must find that exact text in a matching file. A feature whose 'hidden_in_release' evidence is all present is labelled 'Debug builds only', not 'In the beta'.

features.name: PrompTugal.news in the app
features.what: The live PrompTugal.news site opens in the app, with its own page and Back history, and updates the moment the site is released.

features.name: Offline reader
features.what: Native Now, Agenda, Saved and News lists, kept on the device for when the venue Wi-Fi fails. Every time is shown in Lisbon time.

features.name: Try with sample data
features.what: "Who are you?" offers "Try with sample data": every team screen fills with made-up people and data that ship with the app, with a banner to turn it off.

features.name: One schedule
features.what: Sessions picked on the website and sessions saved in the app become one list, in the website's own format, so a pick made in one place shows in the other.

features.name: Website and app talk to each other
features.what: A small, fixed set of messages between the website and the app, checked against a list of allowed sites. No message ever returns a key.

features.name: Reminders before sessions
features.what: A notification before each picked session, with the venue, in Lisbon time.

features.name: The news, native and web side by side
features.what: The PrompTugal feed, newsletter editions and stories as native lists, next to the same pages on the web.

features.name: Your encrypted vault on the phone
features.what: A vault reader written in Swift with Apple's own cryptography. It reads your encrypted vault, keeps a local cache and syncs only what changed. The server only ever holds ciphertext.

features.name: Face ID or passcode unlock
features.what: Vault keys stay on this device, in the Keychain, behind Face ID or the device passcode. The app never stores a vault key without one. Keys are never synced, logged or shown.

features.name: Trusted signers and your own vault
features.what: A vault's changes count only when signed by a key you trust: "Trust this signer" adds one. "Make this my vault" says which vault is yours, so a teammate's imported vault never is.

features.name: The graph, drawn natively
features.what: The PrompTugal.news graph of companies, people, events and topics, drawn as a native view you can pan and search.

features.name: Ask, with your own key
features.what: Chat about the agenda, your picks and the news, using your own OpenRouter key, kept in the Keychain and sent only to openrouter.ai and the model provider you choose.

features.name: Ask asks first
features.what: Before the first message, Ask says what it sends and to whom, and sends nothing until you allow it. Each kind of context has its own switch; only the public agenda is on by default.

features.name: Reading meter top-up in the app
features.what: The website's reading meter, topped up with an Apple in-app purchase instead of a card link. Hidden in release builds until it does something in the app; available in builds from Xcode for testing.

features.name: What the team is doing
features.what: Native iPad dashboards of the team: who is here, what needs a decision, what is overdue and what is named for me, built from the team site's public data and cached for offline use.

features.name: What the agents are doing
features.what: The agents' wakes, reports, pulse check-ins and log, in one native view, newest first.

features.name: Newsroom status
features.what: The newsroom's desks, stories in progress and decisions waiting, from its published JSON.

features.name: Briefed
features.what: My stand-up briefings, the brief packs and the decisions waiting on me, in one place.

features.name: Messages through vaults
features.what: Append-only lanes in the vault for notes to teammates and tips to the newsroom. Only people with the vault's keys can read them.

features.name: Report and block
features.what: Every message can be reported, and its lane or sender blocked on this device; blocked lanes and senders are listed and can be unblocked.

features.name: Where is everyone
features.what: Teammates' picks, read from the vaults they choose to share, next to your own schedule.

features.name: The wall
features.what: For an iPad on a stand: the team, the agents and the newsroom on one screen, refreshing by itself.

features.name: Debug panels
features.what: Every request the app makes, every vault read and decryption step with its size and timing, the bridge messages, storage and the build. Which keys exist and where, never their values. Debug mode is turned on in Settings.

features.name: Private in the app switcher
features.what: When the app leaves the screen, a cover hides its contents, so the app switcher never shows keys, messages or a conversation.

features.name: Traffic and status charts
features.what: Website traffic and newsroom status as native charts on iPad, next to the web originals.
